Loss and grief change far more than our emotions and mindset. They can shake our identity, our relationships, our sense of belonging, and of place. They disrupt our understanding of what it means to be alive.

In these podcasts, through the lenses of psychotherapy, spirituality, religion, and sometimes through psychic experience, I explore the deeper questions which loss and grief raise. Questions such as these.  Where do I belong now? Who's here for me? What's it all for anyway? In short, existential questions concerning meaning and purpose when the people we love, when the pets we love, when the places we love and are rooted in, cease to be in our life as before. 

Alone and with invited guests, I pay attention to the profound impact which loss and grief have on our lives. Together, we allow the questions they awaken in us to deepen our understanding of ourselves, of one another, and of what it means to live well with grief.

description:
Blessings and greetings, I am Abigail and I am madly in love with the adventure that is the human emotional experience. On ‘Nose to the Mirror,' we are all about self- honesty and confronting big feelings head- on. We analyze deep,  dense, and complex emotions, and bless them with an unwavering commitment to joy, whimsy, and magic. 


I’m gonna tell it to you straight… despite what society has taught you, you NEED to listen to your heart and believe in your dreams!!! You have one life- apathy and self-suppression is just not an option. Listening to your heart is a basic need- it is urgent and it is important. But how do we really do that in a world like this? That’s the sort of thing we’ll discover together every week on ‘Nose to the Mirror’. 


Emotional suppression is one of the most sinister illnesses infecting our society today. The things we refuse to confront fester inside of us and block us from growing into our most powerful selves. I believe that it is my purpose to combat this through bravery and acceptance. I want to take you with me on a journey of looking deeper and deeper into the cacophony of feelings that we all hold, but don’t fully understand. Together, we will collect hundreds of ways to deepen our commitments to our hearts, in the name of survival and freedom. The human emotional world is an ever-evolving work of abstract art. It is painful, it is exhausting, and it is stunningly mystical and thrilling. The deeper inside you go, the more opportunities you find to feel real life magic.

description:
Mantle Awaken Nation is a platform dedicated to awakening, equipping, and empowering men to live with purpose, integrity, and lasting influence. Through authentic conversations, practical wisdom, and inspiring stories, we challenge men to embrace their given calling, lead with character, and leave a legacy that impacts families, communities, and future generations. 

Whether you're a young man searching for direction, a father shaping the next generation, or a leader seeking to grow in your influence, Mantle Awaken Nation provides the tools, insights, and encouragement to help you become the man you were created to be. 

Our mission is to build men of purpose, integrity, and influence by entrusting leadership, responsibility, and a vision for lasting impact to the next generation. 

Every episode is an invitation to rise, lead courageously, and carry the mantle that will transform lives for years to come. We encourage men and women to connect and share their wisdom with the world

title: The Dating Goblin
author: The Dating Goblin
description:
Dating stories • Goblin wisdom • Zero shame 
Welcome to The Dating Goblin! 
The anonymous podcast where modern dating gets analyzed with honesty, humour, and chaos. 
Every week we dive into dating apps, first dates, green flags, red flags, communication, relationships, attachment styles, polyamory, heartbreak, and the wonderfully awkward moments that come with trying to connect with other humans.
Or robots... I swear one was a robot. 
Grab your favourite drink, get f*cking cozy, and join the goblin as we laugh, cringe, cry, and figure out modern dating together.

title: Winning at Work
author: John Caldwell
description:
Work is too important for bad advice. Winning at Work is the podcast for people navigating their careers without the fluff, "hustle porn," or theories from people who’ve never been in the room.
Host John Caldwell spent 35 years at the sharp end of music and gambling. He sold 40M records as a label president and helped build the online poker industry. He’s made and lost fortunes, managed legends, and built teams from scratch.
No scripts, no guests, no theory. Just honest stories and straight talk about what it takes to win—and what winning actually means.

title: Girl, Plies
author: Katwilson
description: 4 Friends. 1 Conservatory. 20 Years Later. Join me and my friends as we go through the ins and outs of the dance world. We cover the good, the bad, and the ugly we have witnessed or experienced in the dance industry over the past two decades. Episode 1 Coming Soon!!!

author: Selin Aura
description:
Tarot, minus the gatekeeping. Every episode explains one tarot card in about five minutes: what it means upright and reversed, what it says in love and career, and the yes-or-no answer everyone secretly wants.

From the team behind Deckaura.com, home of 30+ free tools: tarot readings, birth chart and angel number calculators, rune casting, and a live moon phase tracker. New episodes weekly.

title: Chief Mama Officer
author: Jennie Yang
description:
At Chief Mama Officer, we believe the most powerful thing you can build is yourself. 
This is a podcast for women founders, investors, and anyone curious about how women are redefining power: women who are ready to lead more fully with both strength and soul, ambition and ease, and drive and depth.
We talk purpose, wellbeing, wealth — and the inner work that makes it all possible.

title: Scéal Éireann: Stories from Ireland
author: Michael McGowan
description: Scéal Éireann: Stories from Ireland is a weekly podcast exploring Ireland's rich history, culture, landscapes, and traditions. Join us as we uncover remarkable people, memorable places, and the stories that have shaped a nation—and continue to inspire people around the world.

title: This Is Why We’re Friends
author: Kaycie Golic and Mikayla Paletta
description:
We’re Kaycie and Mikayla—best friends who somehow survive each other’s terrible ideas. Every episode is filled with unfiltered conversations, wild stories, unpopular opinions, relationship debates, embarrassing confessions, and the kind of laughs that make your stomach hurt.
Some episodes will make you laugh, some might make you rethink your own opinions, and others will leave you wondering how we’re still functioning adults. 
If you’ve ever laughed until you cried with your best friend, this podcast is for you. Grab a drink, get comfortable, and prepare to become part of the group chat 🩵

title: Morsels from Heaven by Toby Taylor
author: Momentum Media Advertising
description: This season of Morsels from Heaven by Toby Taylor V2 invites you on an extraordinary journey to unlock divine wisdom embedded in everyday language. We'll unpack profound spiritual insights from Toby Taylor's unique book, guiding you from confusion to clarity, empowering you to live a purposeful life filled with deep faith and unshakeable joy. Get ready to transform your understanding of God's word and your place within His grand design.  By the end of this transformative series, you'll gain practical tools to navigate life's toughest challenges, embracing adversity with newfound strength and courage, knowing God is working in your trials. You'll solidify your understanding of your divine identity, recognizing your worth as fearfully and wonderfully made, free from external validation. Moreover, you'll learn to actively administer Agape love in all relationships, discern true abundance from worldly traps, and cultivate consistent spiritual growth that keeps you anchored in God's will and purpose, ultimately securing your eternal legacy.  This season is meticulously crafted for the seeker yearning to deepen their faith, find true purpose, and overcome life's obstacles with God's guidance. If you're ready to break free from old mindsets, embrace your unique divine identity, and live a life aligned with spiritual freedom and eternal joy, then this journey into 'Morsels from Heaven' is specifically for you.

title: Bible Study With The Homies
author: Hardly Initated Network
description:
*Bible Study with the Homies* is a weekly gathering where Scripture meets real life. This isn’t about religion, denominations, or pretending to have all the answers. It’s about opening the Bible, asking honest questions, challenging each other, and discovering what God’s Word actually says.
Whether you’re new to the Bible, returning to your faith, or have been walking with Christ for years, you’ll find authentic conversations, practical teaching, and a community committed to growing together. Every episode breaks down biblical truth in a way that’s understandable, relevant, and applicable to everyday life, covering relationships, purpose, business, family, culture, spiritual warfare, and living as disciples of Jesus.
Come as you are. Bring your Bible, your questions, and your perspective. Let’s study the Word, sharpen one another, and grow in Christ together.
*Bible Study with the Homies* because faith was never meant to be lived alone.

title: The Safe to Love Again Podcast with Dr. Gary Salyer
author: Dr. Gary Salyer
description:
What if lasting love was never a matter of luck—or of finally finding the one right person—but of how your brain learned the rules of love in the first place?

 

For almost twenty years, Dr. Gary Salyer has helped singles and couples change the patterns that quietly run the show: choosing the wrong people, losing the right ones, and bracing for the moment love turns unsafe. On Safe to Love Again, he brings together attachment theory and the neuroscience of how the brain rewrites itself to explain why we love the way we do—and how those deep rules can change.

 

You'll discover what real love is actually meant to feel like—not as an idea, but in your body, your nervous system, and the relationships you build. And you'll begin to reclaim what was always yours: the power to choose love wisely, create it on purpose, and know how to keep it.

This isn't about trying harder at love. It's about changing what your brain expects love to be, so you can stop repeating the past and finally build something that lasts.

 

Come home to secure love. Learn how to choose it—and keep it.

title: Cemetery Shrooms
author: The Redheaded Cryptid
description: Keeping the myths and the memories alive through old stories, urban legends, tales of the supernatural, paranormal, and unexplained. Follow Jeb and Earyaan as explore Legends both past and present, concrete and cryptid, urban and rural.

title: The Murphy Cheatham Podcast
author: Murphy Cheatham
description: Hosted by Murphy Cheatham, this podcast brings real conversations about leadership, business, relationships, culture, and the decisions that shape long careers. With more than 20 years in high-stakes environments, Murphy sits down with professionals, leaders, athletes, and change-makers to share lessons, stories, and perspectives you won’t hear anywhere else.Built on one philosophy: Measure twice. Cut once.

title: Soft Chaos
author: Angelina Grey
description:
Soft Chaos is a conversation podcast hosted by longtime radio broadcaster Angelina Grey, exploring music, creativity, identity and the lives happening behind the highlight reel.
From studio to school gate, backstage to bin night. These are curious, occasionally sideways conversations about the different versions of ourselves... and how anyone manages to hold them all together.
Expect musicians, comedians, actors and other interesting minds, with a few neurospicy side quests along the way.
New episodes fortnightly on Wednesdays, with the odd Soft Chaos Mini dropping in between to keep you on your toes.
See you in the conversation pit.

title: The Last Makers
author: David Shaw Furniture
description:
Some stories deserve to be preserved.

Today, we're honoured to share another conversation from The Last Makers a podcast celebrating the people who continue to build, create and manufacture right here in New Zealand.

Behind every enduring business is a story of resilience, reinvention, craftsmanship and purpose. These conversations aren't just about business; they're about the people, the lessons, and the legacy they're leaving behind.

If you believe great ideas are built over decades, not days, this podcast is for you.

Listen now, and join us as we preserve the wisdom of New Zealand's last makers.

title: Accidentally Homeless
author: Mika Basson
description:
Accidentally Homeless is a storytelling podcast about what happens when ordinary life suddenly stops making sense. One day my mom and I had a home. The next, we were living in our car. What followed wasn't just homelessness—it was baboon burglaries, beach parking lots, impossible decisions, survival systems, dark humour, hunger, hope, and the strange logic that only exists when you're trying to make it through one more day.
This isn't a story about hardship. It's a story about two ordinary people navigating circumstances designed to wipe them off the board, finding laughter in the worst place

description: Welcome to Hewacast—the official podcast of the Ethiopian Space Science Society (ESSS). Join our team of space scientists, astronomers, and engineers as we explore the cosmos from an Ethiopian perspective. Every two weeks, we bring you the latest in space news, satellite missions, and astronomy developments. Whether we are breaking down complex cosmic phenomena, discussing Ethiopia’s growing aerospace sector, or answering questions directly from our community, Hewacast is your premier frequency for all things space. Tune in, and let's explore the universe together.

title: Her AI Era Podcast
author: Kinsey Soderberg & Joyce Hamilton
description:
Two women entrepreneurs. Two businesses mid-merge into one. And AI wired through every piece of it.

Kinsey Soderberg and Joyce Hamilton are the co-founders of Her AI Club™ and hosts of the Her AI Era Summit — and on this show, they're opening the books. Launch debriefs with the numbers. Event debriefs with the stuff that flopped. Reaction episodes where they each play with a new tool for 30 minutes, then hop on to compare notes. And interviews with women building cool things with AI inside their businesses — the "wait, you're doing WHAT with Claude?" conversations.

Every episode opens with the most unhinged thing they did with AI this week, and closes with one thing you can go try in yours.

Nerdy, fun, and honest — made for the woman who's the most AI-obsessed person in every room she's in. You're not the only one anymore. Come nerd out with us.

New episodes every Monday. Learn more at herai.club.

title: Ep 01 - Help Agents Win Contests & Master Transaction Plans w/ Josh Jaster
author: Kyle Reedstrom
description: Josh Jaster is a PLACE operator serving the Fargo, North Dakota market, where he leads a lean, high-performing real estate team. With nearly a decade in real estate, he has grown his business to 80–100 transactions annually while maintaining strong profitability and focusing on scalable systems. Summary.  In this episode, Josh Jaster shares insights on scaling a real estate business, leveraging community and systems, and maintaining growth momentum through strategic pattern interrupts and team engagement.

author: andrew azevedo
description: Unpacked is a podcast about setting down what you've been carrying. Hosted by Andrew Azevedo of Calm-Ops Hypnosis, each episode blends plain-spoken conversation with guided techniques to help you quiet a busy mind, sleep better, and find some steadiness — built for military, veteran, and first-responder listeners, and anyone who's used to carrying the load for everyone else. You have the power. We set it in motion.

author: Gail Chisholm
description:
The Unstuck Edit is a weekly podcast with Gail Chisholm, exploring identity, embodiment and the courage to become yourself again. 
Through honest stories and thoughtful conversations, each episode invites you to pause, reflect and let go of what no longer fits. No hustle. No life hacks. Just gentle, real conversations for women navigating change, building confidence and creating a life that feels more like their own.

title: Beyond Should: women reinventing their lives, careers & owning their power
author: Lucy Reynolds
description:
Beyond Should is a podcast about breaking down the barriers of our “shoulds.”

“I should stay in this job… I should take that meeting… I shouldn’t say how I really feel… I should, I should, I should.” Sound familiar?
But what if everything powerful, beautiful, true, and authentic lives on the other side of should?

Hosted by Lucy Reynolds, certified coach and founder of The Murmuration Collective, Beyond Should invites listeners to stop living in their “shoulds” and start naming, claiming, and pursuing what they deeply want. Through stories, wisdom, and candid conversations with inspiring guests — thought leaders, creative minds, advocates, artists, entrepreneurs, and storytellers — each episode explores courage, self-trust, asking for help, embracing failure, and stepping into a more vibrant, authentic way of living.

Expect laughter, honesty, vulnerability, and the occasional f-bomb as we challenge cultural conditioning, shed inherited expectations, and reclaim personal power.

Because when we show up boldly, we elevate not only our own lives — but the world around us.

Beyond Should premieres on Tuesday, March 10th in honor of Women's History Month. New episodes will be out every other Tuesday. 

Follow on Apple Podcast, Spotify, or wherever good podcasts are found. See you on the other side of Should!

title: Rocketship Reads
author: Bookmarked London
description:
In the not-too-distant future, earth is in peril. 

In preparation for global meltdown, we are sending people into space aboard a tiny rocketship.

They can take with them 7 books.

The first 5 are their favourites, the 6th is one they hate so much they get to throw it into space to consign it to obscurity, and the 7th is the book they would commit to the cannon, for which humanity will be remembered.

Co-produced by Bookmarked London and Morocco Bound Bookshop, and hosted by Adam RW, welcome to Rocketship Reads.

title: Crispy Bits
author: Crispy Bits Series
description: Bite into some juicy stories through rich, in-depth discourse with guests that have an impact on the Australian East Coast. We explore the personal journeys of guests with unique skills, careers, or influences tracing what "herbs and spices" have added to their flavourful experiences in life.

title: Tales from the Dark Web
author: Forbidden Knowledge Network
description:
Tales from the Dark Web is a first-person storytelling podcast featuring unsettling encounters, unexplained events, internet mysteries, paranormal experiences, strange coincidences, disappearances, stalkers, UFO sightings, cryptid encounters, haunted locations, wilderness horror, anonymous confessions, and disturbing discoveries.

Each episode presents a story that sounds real, could be real, or has enough believable detail to make listeners question where fact ends and fiction begins.

The show avoids recycled creepypasta, excessive gore, cheap shock value, and generic stories that have already been narrated hundreds of times.

title: Next Level Gamer
author: Xbox GamerTag Generator
description: Next Level Gamer is the podcast for Xbox players, gamers, and creative minds looking to build a memorable gaming identity. Each episode explores Gamertag ideas, gaming trends, username strategies, Xbox tips, and personal branding in the gaming world. Whether you're choosing your first Gamertag or searching for a legendary new one, you'll find inspiration, practical advice, and creative ideas to help you stand out every time you play.

title: Colaboratorio Agua
author: Colaboratorio Agua
description:
Esto es Confluencias: Un podcast que forma parte del Colaboratorio Agua, proyecto de investigación aplicada coordinado desde la ENES Morelia de la UNAM.
En este espacio juntamos miradas interdisciplinarias, feministas y de ciencia ciudadana para acercarnos a las problemáticas actuales relacionadas con el abasto de agua. Compartimos avances, dudas, discusiones, y lo que iremos construyendo con comunidades que enfrentan el desabasto día a día.
Va para todas las personas interesadas en la justicia hídrica y en cómo la construimos en colectivo.
El proyecto “Colaboratorio Agua. Exploraciones interdisciplinares feministas para una ciencia ciudadana a favor de la justicia hídrica” recibe financiamiento de la convocatoria Ciencia Básica y de Frontera de la Secretaría de Ciencia, Humanidades, Tecnología e Innovación (Secihti) y es coordinado desde la ENES Unidad Morelia.

description: One of the two Historical novels Charles Dickens wrote, Barnaby Rudge is set around the ‘Gordon’ riots in London in 1780. The story begins in 1775 with Barnaby, his Mother, and his talking Raven Grip, fleeing their home from a blackmailer, and going into hiding. Joe Willet similarly finds he must leave his home to escape his Father’s ire, leaving behind the woman he loves. Five years later these characters, and many others whose lives we have followed, find themselves caught up in the horrific Protestant rioting led by Sir George Gordon. The mob which reaches 100,000 strong, gets out of hand, and there is danger to all in the path of their destruction. Charles Dickens skillfully weaves the lives of his many loving and many wicked characters through the rioting, and shows how this uprising changes so many lives. As a side note, Edgar Allan Poe is said to have been inspired by Barnaby’s raven Grip when he wrote his famous poem,”The Raven”. (Summary by Mil Nicholson)

description:
Tired of hearing "everything looks normal" and still not seeing those two pink lines?
Welcome to The Fertility Fight Club - a safe space for women trying to conceive to get real answers, real support, and real hope. I'm Crystal, Holistic Nutritionist and Fertility Coach, and after nine years of my own fertility journey - miscarriages, an ectopic pregnancy, and finally becoming a mom to twins through surrogacy - I know exactly how lonely and confusing this road can feel. This podcast is what I wish I'd had.
Every week, we're covering it all: getting pregnant naturally, IUI, IVF, egg and sperm donation, surrogacy, PCOS, endometriosis, low AMH, unexplained infertility, and everything in between. You'll hear from doctors, embryologists, and fertility experts who'll help you understand what's actually going on in your body - so you can stop Googling at 2am and start moving the needle on your fertility.
We'll also bring you Love Your Story, a series featuring real fertility warriors - women who've been in the trenches, who are still fighting, and who are living proof that you can get to the other side with a baby in your arms.
We’ll also have The Fertility Pulse, your inside look at what’s happening in the fertility world. Crystal and nurse Lindsay share the latest updates, what they’re seeing in practice, and realistic ways you can take action on your fertility journey.  
Then we will have Crystal Clear Fertility, where Crystal breaks down fertility education, new research, treatments, trends, and important updates from the fertility world in a way that actually makes sense. She’ll also share what’s happening behind the scenes at Fertility Blooms, inside the Fertility Fight Club, upcoming events, guest experts, new resources, and the real conversations happening within the community. 
Because this journey is hard enough. You shouldn't have to do it alone. Whether you're just starting to try, deep in the trenches of treatment, or trying again a little later in life, you belong here.
Hit subscribe and let's get you those two positive lines.

description:
The year is 1944, and the world is at war. Overseas, the first American boats are crashing onto blood-stained beaches, but there are battles on the home front too. With the help of an ironically pacifistic actor, the show quickly becomes a meteoric hit. Millions of Americans tune in each week to hear the propagandists lionize their heroes and demonize their enemies. But the propagandists' newfound success is troubled with logistical nightmares and ethical questions. And worst of all: their open invitation for dramatic stories has invited something unthinkable through the door, a story that will put both of their lives at risk.

  • Clips and conversations from my podcast with lawyers, operators, and industry leaders
  • A behind-the-scenes look at how modern firms are actually evolving

Because here’s the reality: 

AI is not replacing lawyers.
But lawyers who use AI well are replacing those who don’t.

If you want a smarter, more efficient, and more valuable law practice! Subscribe and let’s get to work.

title: Becoming a 5-Star Stylist
author: Robert Alexander
description: “Becoming a 5-Star Stylist” is a podcast that takes you on a journey through the world of hairstyling, offering insights and tips from industry expert Robert Alexander. Each episode delves into the skills, strategies, and secrets behind building a successful hairstyling career, from mastering techniques to creating a luxury client experience. Whether you’re a seasoned stylist or just starting out, this podcast is your go-to resource for elevating your craft and becoming a 5-Star Stylist!

title: Unfiltered in Israel
author: Shalom Khai
description: Welcome to my Israel diary! An honest, sometimes funny, and sometimes painful diary of daily life, lessons, faith, and culture in the Holy Land. Join me as I navigate the raw, unscripted reality of living in Israel—from the chaotic cultural mishaps to the deeper moments of personal growth.

title: The Every Day Leader with Brennan Washington
author: Brennan Washington
description:
Leadership isn't reserved for CEOs, pastors, coaches, or people with a title—it's something every one of us practices every single day.

Whether you're leading a business, raising kids, serving on a team, building a marriage, growing in your faith, or simply trying to become a better version of yourself, this podcast is designed to help you lead with greater purpose, clarity, and consistency.


Each episode, Pastor Brennan Washington shares practical leadership principles, personal lessons, conversations with influential leaders, and actionable strategies that will challenge you to grow in every area of life—because the way you lead your everyday life shapes the legacy you'll leave.

If you're committed to becoming the leader your family, team, community, and future deserve, you're in the right place.


New episodes every other week.


Follow Brennan for more leadership content:
YouTube & Instagram: @brennanwashington

title: Still Running Strong
author: Still Running Strong
description:
Welcome to Still Running Strong — a new podcast for midlife women who love ultra running. Not the elites, not the podium finishers — the mid-pack, the back-of-the-packers, the ones who are just there for the love of it.

In this taster episode, hosts Becky and Dawn introduce themselves, share the (slightly smelly) story of how they met at an ultra race in Greece, and talk about why midlife might just be the strongest chapter yet — even while their bodies are changing shape around them.

Expect honest conversations about perimenopause and menopause from lived experience (not medical advice — they're very clear on that), the friendships that ultra running builds, and why this podcast is for absolutely anyone who runs, walks, or ultra-walks their way through a race.


In This Episode

●      Who Becky and Dawn are, and what “mid-pack” really means

●      How they met — a running retreat kitchen in the Lakes, and an unforgettable moment in a tent in Greece

●      Why midlife is a new chapter, not a decline

●      What listeners can expect from the show: real stories, practical tips, and guests with their own journeys to tell

●      Why this isn't a professional advice podcast — just two women sharing what's worked for them


Connect With Us

Follow us on Instagram and Facebook for updates on new episodes, and get in touch if you've got a story to share — we'd love to have you as a guest.

 

Still Running Strong is for general interest and entertainment only. We share our own personal experiences, not professional medical, nutritional, or training advice. Always consult a qualified professional before making changes to your training, diet, or health.

title: PEACE | Participate in Europe
author: Erasmus+ INDIRE

Participate in Europe is a podcast bringing together the four introductory episodes of the Participate in Europe video series, developed to promote a deeper understanding of the European Union, its founding values, institutions, and democratic processes. Drawing on the educational modules created within the European project P.E.A.C.E. – Participation Erasmus Alumni for Civic Engagement, the podcast provides an accessible introduction to civic and political participation in Europe. Aimed primarily at young people, Erasmus+ participants, and learners, it also offers valuable insights for anyone interested in strengthening their knowledge of European citizenship and encouraging active engagement in democratic life.

title: ELEVATE with Andrew Weingart
author: Andrew Weingart
description:
ELEVATE with Andrew Weingart is a podcast about becoming the person your success requires.


Each episode explores the connection between identity, mindset, discipline, awareness, and personal growth because lasting success is never built from the outside in. It’s built from the inside out.

Whether you’re an entrepreneur, leader, professional, or someone committed to becoming the highest version of yourself, ELEVATE will challenge the way you think, break limiting patterns, and equip you with practical strategies to create greater influence, fulfillment, and results.


Through honest conversations and actionable insights, Andrew connects personal transformation to real-world outcomes—helping you strengthen your mindset, deepen your self-awareness, and lead with greater purpose and intention.


Because elevation isn’t about chasing success.

It’s about becoming the person success naturally follows.


Welcome to ELEVATE.

title: Enhanced Perception
author: Ike Onuoha
description:
Embark on a transformative journey of self-discovery and empowerment with Enhanced Perception, your trusted guide to unlocking your true potential. Join us as we explore the depths of self-improvement, cultivate a growth mindset, establish powerful goal-setting strategies, navigate the intricacies of business management, and cultivate an unwavering belief in yourself.

Visit Ikemotivationblog: https://ikemotivationblog.com/today and start your journey to personal and professional growth.

title: Sounds of Today
author: One sound One day
description:
(Description in French below)
A collection of moments you can hear. No scripts. No filters.
Just the sounds of everyday life, captured as they happen.
From quiet mornings and busy streets to coffee shops, stores, nature, restaurants, birds, waves, conversations, and the little sounds we often walk past without noticing , each episode is a small window into a place, a moment, a feeling.
Think of it like a TV series, but instead of watching the story… you listen to it.
Each season explores a different chapter of life, and each episode invites you to pause, close your eyes, and experience a place through sound.
Une collection de moments à écouter. Sans scénario. Sans filtre.
Rien que les sons du quotidien, saisis sur le vif.
Des matins paisibles aux rues animées, en passant par les cafés, les magasins, la nature, les restaurants, le chant des oiseaux, le bruit des vagues, les conversations et ces petits sons que l'on croise souvent sans y prêter attention : chaque épisode est une fenêtre ouverte sur un lieu, un instant, une émotion.
Imaginez une série télévisée, mais où, au lieu de regarder l'histoire se dérouler... vous l'écoutez.
Chaque saison explore un chapitre différent de la vie, et chaque épisode vous invite à faire une pause, à fermer les yeux et à découvrir un lieu à travers le son.

description:
Hi! Jules here! We're just going to talk about anything, maybe invite some people over... 
My interests go from True Crime to making fun of city names, from talking about happy stuff to making somewhat of a motivational speech.

title: The Celebration Archive
author: Samantha C
description:
Where meaningful celebrations are preserved, shared, and reimagined. 

The Celebration Archive is a podcast dedicated to the stories, artistry, and thoughtful details behind life's most meaningful celebrations. Each episode explores the world of weddings, events, floral design, hospitality, and creative entrepreneurship through conversations with industry experts, inspiring hosts, and real couples.

From planning timeless weddings and designing unforgettable guest experiences to discovering emerging trends, business insights, and creative inspiration, The Celebration Archive is a curated collection of ideas, knowledge, and stories that celebrate the moments that matter most.

Whether you're planning your own celebration, growing a creative business, or simply appreciate beautiful design and intentional living, this is your place to gather inspiration, learn from experienced professionals, and preserve the art of celebration.

title: Gardens of Earthly Delight
author: Andrew Valenti
description: An exploration of our connection to earth through conversations with experts and celebrities who have formed their own profound relationships to the natural world.

title: You're Not In Charge of the Scale
author: Dr Stephanie Walsh
description: You're Not in Charge of the Scale - Hosted by Dr. Stephanie Walsh, a pediatrician board certified in obesity medicine with over 20 years of experience caring for kids and families struggling with weight.  This podcast is here to normalize conversations about pediatric health — and to say the quiet parts out loud. Each episode digs into the evidence behind weight, hunger, and health, and works to dismantle the shame and stigma that families carry every single day.  If weight were as simple as calories in and calories out, this wouldn't be a podcast. Every family who walks into Dr. Walsh's clinic has already tried the diets, the exercise, and all the things they were told they should be doing. Weight is not a measure of health. Fear and blame don't create change. And you are not in charge of the scale.  Expect honest, evidence-based conversations about GLP-1 medications for kids, food noise, weight bias, the mental health toll of bullying, what actually counts as research, and why obesity is a disease that deserves real treatment — not judgment.  For parents, patients, pediatricians, and anyone who's ever been made to feel like their body is a personal failing.  Dr. Walsh is a pediatrician This podcast shares medical information, not medical advice.

title: Between the Worlds Paranormal Society Podcast
author: Between The Worlds Paranormal Society
description: The Between the Worlds Paranormal Society Podcast explores haunted history, paranormal investigations, spiritual beliefs, folklore, and the occult. Join the BTWPS team as we revisit real investigations, share unexplained experiences, explore the history behind haunted places, and discuss the supernatural from both investigative and spiritual perspectives. We don’t claim to have all the answers; we’re here to ask questions, explore the unknown, and discover what may exist between the worlds.

title: Between Worlds
author: The Arcane Storyteller
description: Between Worlds explores the symbols, beliefs, and rituals that have shaped human civilizations across time. Why do cultures separated by oceans create similar myths, sacred objects, and spiritual traditions? Through history, anthropology, psychology, and philosophy, each episode uncovers the stories behind haunted dolls, mirrors, masks, relics, the evil eye, and more—revealing what these enduring beliefs tell us about the universal human search for meaning.

title: The Manicurist's Gossip Podcast
author: Vanessa Espinola
description:
The best conversations happen when your hands are busy and your nails are under the UV lamp.


Welcome to The Manicurist’s Gossip Podcast  a place where we bring the real conversations from the nail appointment table straight to your headphones.


Hosted by Vanessa Espinola, this isn’t just a podcast about nails or beauty. It’s about the little moments where women open up, share their stories, and have the conversations that stay with you long after the appointment ends.


From life changes and personal growth to womanhood, relationships, dreams, and everything in between, this is your cozy corner for honest chats, laughter, reflection, and connection.


Because behind every manicure, there’s a story.

So grab your coffee, imagine your favourite nail appointment, and join us at the table.

title: In the mood for wine: The Business of Wine
author: Sara Danese
description:
Conversations with the people shaping the world of wine—from renowned winemakers, critics and merchants to finance professors, economists and industry pioneers. 
In each episode The Business of Wine explores the ideas, trends and decisions driving the global wine industry.

author: Tempus & Grey
description:
Tempus & Grey is where new-school energy meets old-school mindset. Hosted by voices from both sides of the game, From culture and business to relationships, trends, and straight-up controversy — nothing is off limits.

We keep it real, unfiltered, and sometimes uncomfortable, because the best conversations usually are. Expect honest opinions, different perspectives, and the kind of back-and-forth that doesn’t always end in agreement — but always leaves you thinking.

If you’re into raw discussions, sharp insights, and conversations that don’t play it safe, you’re in the right place.

title: Amy Lou Out Loud
author: Amy Wade • Amy Lou Out Loud
description: Welcome to Amy Lou Out Loud, where current events meet common sense. Together, we’ll explore today’s headlines, the history behind them, and the ideas that continue to shape America. Whether we’re talking about faith, freedom, family, or culture, this is a place for thoughtful conversations, honest questions, and a little perspective in a noisy world. I’m glad you’re here.

title: The Riparian Collective's podcast
author: The Riparian Collective
description:
A quote on Twitter about how peaceful nature is sent me down a rabbit hole.

We often talk about nature as if it exists in a permanent state of harmony. But look closer and you'll find competition, decay, predation, adaptation, and constant change. Nature is not peaceful because it is free from conflict. Nature endures because relationships persist through conflict.

The Riparian Collective explores the world through the lens of relationships. Between people and places. Between waste and value. Between communities and ecosystems. Between what we consume and what remains.

By examining the connections that shape our lives, we seek a deeper understanding of the systems we inhabit and how we can better serve both the world and its inhabitants.

Nature is always evolving, changing, becoming. So are we.

Welcome to The Riparian Collective.

If you’ve felt stuck in patterns, holding onto what hurts, or questioning the story you’ve been living, this is your space. We talk real — no fluff — about beliefs, habits, emotional patterns, growth, healing, and becoming. You’ll feel seen, challenged lovingly, and inspired to stretch into new possibilities. title: The Hospitality Builders
author: John Richardson
description:
You can run a café for fifteen years, put every day of your life into it, and find at the end there's nothing to sell. You ran a business. You never built one.
This show is about the other outcome.
John Richardson built the biggest sandwich business in Ireland by twenty-eight and lost it by twenty-nine. He did it again, and did it properly: restaurants, bars, cafés, chip shops, retail. Fifteen years as an owner-operator, close to a thousand people employed, and he sold every one of them. Twenty-one years since, advising some of the biggest names in the industry.
Freddie Szydlowski came up through operations at Joe & The Juice when it had four sites in the UK, on the floor long before he was anywhere near a laptop. He went on to run marketing for hospitality brands, then co-founded Embargo, and now works directly with 3500 venues helping them grow - with the entire set of data behind it - week in, week out.
Some episodes we sit down with operators at different stages of growth. Some it's just the two of us taking something apart. Either way it comes with a tool or a resource you can put straight into yours, and it's about how a hospitality business gets built and grown, not just run.

title: Authentically Imperfect™️
author: Natasia Athwal
description:
Authentically Imperfect™ is a faith-centered podcast and community for women who have never quite fit the mold.
Created for the woman who has felt different, overlooked, rejected, or misunderstood, this show offers honest conversations about faith, identity, belonging, emotional health, personal growth, purpose, and becoming who God created you to be.
Through personal stories, biblical reflection, practical insight, and meaningful conversations, host Natasia Athwal explores what it looks like to follow God without pretending to have everything figured out. Together, we unpack perfectionism, rejection, grief, transition, calling, leadership, relationships, and the courage it takes to grow and lead authentically.
You do not have to prove yourself, perform perfectly, or change who you are to belong here.
Come as you are. Grow in faith. Find community. Become without the pressure to be perfect.
Because being different was never a mistake.

title: The Dona KAPP Show
author: Dona Kappmeyer
description:
The Dona KAPP Show features honest conversations with business owners, entrepreneurs, executives, and community leaders about business, life, and the ripple effect created by the choices we make.
Hosted by business coach, consultant, speaker, author, and entrepreneur Dona Kappmeyer, each episode goes to explore the experiences that shaped her guests, the challenges that tested them, and the lessons they learned along the way.
Guests share the real stories of building businesses, leading teams, navigating change, overcoming setbacks, and creating meaningful impact. Conversations explore leadership, business growth, and the people whose influence continues to ripple through our businesses, families, and communities. 
Whether you are a business owner, an emerging leader, an entrepreneur, or looking for practical insight and inspiration, The Dona KAPP Show will challenge you to think differently, lead more intentionally, and take action toward what comes next.

Whether you are a veteran teacher or just starting out, these conversations are your blueprint for growth and a masterclass in educational practice.

title: Enable No More Take Back Your Power

description: Enable No More: Take Back Your Power is the podcast for anyone tired of repeating the same cycles in relationships, work, health, or life. Host Jen McCutcheon goes beneath addiction, mental health, and human struggle to the root cause: disconnection from self, from others, and from something greater, God, Source, Universe. Through trauma science, nervous system truth, subconscious reprogramming and spiritual insight, this is your invitation to break the cycles, heal the patterns, and prevent the next generation from carrying what ends with you. See what's really keeping you stuck and take back your power.

title: Everyday Eden with Kathryn Haines

description:
Everyday Eden is a powerful guide to cultivating a life that reflects the hope of heaven through simple mindset shifts, everyday habits, and practical next steps. 
Through insightful conversations with best-selling authors, Bible teachers, leaders, speakers, and everyday followers of Jesus, each episode helps us dig deep and find the unexpected strength we need to live well in an unsteady world. Everyday Eden is hosted by writer, speaker, and Bible teacher Kathryn Haines. You can find her on Instagram @ImKathrynHaines and @EverydayEdenPodcast and subscribe to her Substack, Everyday Eden.

title: The Hayne Retrospective

description:
This podcast series explores the lessons of the Hayne Royal Commission and the role of trust within Australia’s financial services industry, through the perspectives of a regulator, a financial adviser, and a consumer advocate.

Welcome to the Haunted Half-Moon Inn. 
Join me for original tales of terror. I write and narrate paranormal horror stories. Ghosts, vampires, werewolves, monsters and other ancient beings prowl the night. Always remember, just because you don’t see them, doesn’t mean that they aren’t there.

 Is everybody in? The night frights are about to begin!

title: Conversations with Dr. Vassilia
author: Dr. Vassilia Binensztok
description:
Most people don't realize they're living out stories that were written long before they had the words to tell them.


Conversations with Dr. Vassilia explores the unconscious patterns that shape how we love, cope, achieve, and struggle. Hosted by licensed psychotherapist, author, and founder of Juno Counseling & Wellness, Dr. Vassilia Binensztok, the show features thoughtful conversations with experts, public figures, and everyday people whose stories reveal the psychology beneath human behavior. Through discussions of childhood experiences, attachment, trauma, nervous system regulation, relationships, and resilience, you'll gain a deeper understanding of why you do what you do—and how lasting change becomes possible. If you're fascinated by psychology, healing, and the stories beneath the story, you're in the right place.

title: The Listn Podcast
author: Listn
description: Listn is an honest, unfiltered podcast hosted by Natalia and Rebecca, exploring women’s health, hormones, identity, relationships and the realities of modern womanhood. From periods, fertility and perimenopause to burnout, sex, motherhood and self worth, we have the conversations women are too scared to have. With humour, lived experience and expert insight, Listn asks the questions women are thinking but do not always say out loud.

title: In Conversation with Josh Bersin Why 2026 Changes Everything About How We Work
author: Mike Alreend
description:
The workplace is entering a new era, where AI, evolving workforce expectations, and rapid technological innovation are reshaping how organizations operate. In this episode, renowned HR industry analyst *Josh Bersin* shares his perspective on why *2026* marks a pivotal moment for the future of work. Explore how business leaders can prepare for AI-driven transformation, develop future-ready talent, and create organizations that are more agile, resilient, and people-focused. The discussion covers leadership, workforce planning, skills development, employee experience, and the strategic role of Learning and Development in navigating change. Whether you're a CEO, CHRO, CLO, HR executive, or talent leader, this conversation offers valuable insights into the trends redefining work and the practical actions organizations can take to stay competitive in an increasingly dynamic business environment.
https://www.infoprolearning.com/podcast/in-conversation-with-josh-bersin-why-2026-changes-everything-about-how-we-work/

title: Seen. Heard. Imagined.®
author: Michelle Francine
description:
A spiritual podcast series rooted in sacred text found in 1 Corinthians 2:9 (NIV or ESV) of the Bible. Although no human being can conceive what God has destined for their life, this series explores what guests have seen, heard, or imagined in the development of their spirituality. It’s about those experiences that have strengthen their belief and faith in our Creator.
New content will be released every Thursday until the season ends in September.

title: French Weird
author: Russell Williams
description:
Forget the accordion music, the cafés and the immaculate boulevards. There is a dark, uncanny and deeply strange texture pervading modern France—and it’s time to investigate.

Welcome to French Weird, a podcast dedicated to exploring the counterculture, obscure art and bizarre anomalies of contemporary France. Channeling cultural theory, esoterica and the love of a good book this shows investigates what falls through the cracks of mainstream French culture. We are tracking the liminal spaces, the bizarre subcultures and the beautiful freak-outs from the mid-twentieth century to the present day.

What exactly is the French Weird? It is the territory where high philosophy meets the profoundly bizarre. In each episode, we trace the threads of a proudly rational nation simultaneously digesting global weirdness and exporting its own brand of the mysterious.

French Weird explores how France's hidden eccentricities reveal the truths about its politics, literature, culture and - maybe even - identity.

Subscribe now, download, and join us. When the going gets weird, the pros turn French.


For more information, or to get in touch, visit www.frenchweird.com

title: BRAND:NEW
author: Donovan Fourie
description:
BRAND:NEW is the straight-talking podcast for business owners who want a stronger brand without the marketing jargon.

Hosted by Donovan, a Creative Head and Brand Champion with over 30 years of global experience, each 5–10 minute episode breaks down the principles of professional brand design—from logos and websites to color, typography, messaging, and everything your business says before you say a word.

No fluff. No design-school jargon. Just practical advice, real-world examples, and the occasional war story to help you make smarter branding decisions before you spend a single dollar on design.

New episodes twice a week.

title: Deadly Intentions
author: Deadly Intentions
description: Deadly Intentions is a true-crime podcast hosted by Bubba and Pete, examining the evidence, behavior and hidden motives behind some of the most disturbing criminal cases. From serial killers and cold cases to overlooked clues, police failures and breakthroughs in forensic technology, each episode follows the trail step by step. Serious when it matters, direct when it counts, and always focused on one question: how did they do it, and how were they finally caught? Real cases. Real evidence. No excuses.

title: Brand Insiders
author: Hospitality Net
description: The world of hotel brands is beautifully diverse and constantly evolving, varying by guest profile, scale, region, design, amenities, heritage, and many other attributes. For hoteliers who live and breathe this industry, this variety is a rich tapestry to help travelers of all types discover new destinations. For everyone else, this multiplicity can be dauntingly confusing! Brand Insiders gives a voice to innovative hotel brands. Episodes focus on what makes hotel brands unique, how their operational playbooks generate returns for owners, and how they are meeting the evolving needs of modern travelers. It’s a series for all to learn about industry trends, trendsetting brands, growing categories and emerging markets.

title: Connie’s Diaries
